description: This file defines functions and constants related to managing assistant identities, including resolving, normalizing, and setting default assistant identity properties such as agentId, name, avatar, and emoji.

classes.name: AssistantIdentity
classes.description: Type defining the structure of an assistant's identity, including agentId, name, avatar, and optional emoji.

methods.name: isAvatarUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a valid avatar URL (HTTP or data URL).

methods.name: normalizeAvatarValue
methods.description: Normalizes and validates avatar string values, returning a trimmed, valid avatar URL or path if appropriate.

methods.name: normalizeEmojiValue
methods.description: Normalizes and validates emoji string values, ensuring they are non-ASCII and within length constraints.

methods.name: resolveAssistantIdentity
methods.description: Resolves and constructs an assistant identity object based on configuration, existing identities, and defaults.
